cypressCommandAuthority.scope: Existing token and component values remain historical Groundwork design; they do not govern new Cypress Command work.
cypressCommandAuthority.verificationStatus: This authority pointer does not establish completed QA or deployment.

display.purpose: Cover headline only; Archivo 900 uppercase, max-width 13ch.

headline.purpose: Section h2; Archivo 900 uppercase. Secondary sections step down to clamp(1.3rem,2.3vw,1.75rem) in soft ink.

body.purpose: All prose at Archivo 500; ledes in soft ink; 52-64ch measures.

label.purpose: Folio, running heads, contents strip, table headers, SVG tags; Archivo 700 tracked caps (0.14-0.24em).

numeral.purpose: Besley 900 spot-color act numerals; also 2.6rem in layer chips, 1.1rem in argument rows.

aside.purpose: Besley italic: cover sub, promises, pull quotes, signatures. The human voice; never headings or UI.

file.purpose: Courier Prime, quarantined to the fifteen document file names and the Operator prompt.

headline-quiet.purpose: Stepped-down section h2 for secondary sections (Curriculum, Compare, FAQ), set in soft ink.

statement.purpose: Argument-row declaratives: Archivo 700 short lines with Besley italic smalls beneath.

rule-headline.purpose: The centered one-rule headline (Do not automate chaos).

entry-title.purpose: FAQ questions and ledger entry titles; Besley 600.

signature.purpose: The letter signature line; Besley italic with an Archivo 700 name.

promise.purpose: Layer and act promise lines; Besley italic with Archivo 700 lead-ins.

lede-compact.purpose: Guide-page ledes and compact italic intros; Besley italic.

body-compact.purpose: Secondary prose at 0.97rem: ledger responses, layer prose, FAQ answers.

body-small.purpose: Tertiary prose at 0.95rem, e.g. compare-table cells.

small.purpose: Small utility text at 0.85rem: nav links, mono prompt scale.

note.purpose: Fine annotations at 0.8rem, e.g. the hold hint.

strip.purpose: Contents strip and caption-row labels at 0.78rem tracked caps.

table-head.purpose: Table headers: 0.68rem, ls 0.18em, uppercase, soft ink.

tag.purpose: Act caps and tag chips: 0.62-0.64rem tracked caps.

phase-cap.purpose: Phase caption inside layer chips: 0.58rem tracked caps.

diagram-sub.purpose: SVG diagram secondary text: 12px, soft ink.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing in use: registration settles, hovers (0.18s), reveals (0.6s).

motion.name: register
motion.value: @keyframes register { from { transform: translate(var(--rx), var(--ry)); opacity: .55 } to { transform: translate(0,0); opacity: 1 } }
motion.purpose: The one physics: plates settle into print register. Cover mark runs it at 0.9s staggered 0.1-0.62s.

motion.name: reveal-stagger
motion.value: 16px rise + fade, 0.6s ease-out, 0.08s per part, IntersectionObserver threshold 0.16, delays cleared after 1.1s settle
motion.purpose: Below-fold section entrances. Reduced motion pins final states; hidden tab pauses all animation.

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview: Groundwork is set as a 1950s-60s American corporate identity-program annual report: warm cream uncoated paper, near-black ink, and three earth-tone spot colors (terracotta, mustard, olive) committed at field scale rather than sprinkled as accents. The page reads as a printed document with acts, folios, running heads, ruled schedules, and exhibits; the whole category's dark glowing-tech hero is deliberately refused. Material is flat ink on paper: no shadows, no gradients, no blur, no rounded corners. The page is a single-appearance world with the browser itself themed into it (selection, scrollbar, caret, focus ring). The world covers the whole site: the homepage carries it in inline styles, and the rewritten assets/guide.css (same token set and alias-bridge technique) carries it across the 13 guide pages, legal.html, 404.html, and the Field Guide print shell/PDF. The previous indigo/starlight world no longer exists anywhere on the site. Site-wide brand rasters (favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, the 1200x630 assets/og-card.png) ship with embedded provenance metadata.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper ground with near-black warm ink; flat print material throughout.
Spot color at section scale: an olive letter, a terra-deep audit band, terra-deep layer chips.
Three typographic voices: Archivo grotesque (display and body), Besley slab (numerals and italic asides), Courier Prime (document file names and the Operator prompt only).
Print devices as structure: masthead double rule, folio line, running heads, act numeral lockups, ruled ledgers and schedule tables.
One physics: print registration — elements settle into place from offset positions.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Text-carrying color fields are terra-deep, olive, olive-deep, and ink — always with paper text, all >=5:1. Interactive controls use only ink or terra-deep fills. Bright terra and mustard never carry text; they exist for large marks and decorative fills. (Sole standing exception in the build: the ::selection highlight is terra with paper text — a transient browser surface, not a license for terra text fields.)

rules.name: The Oxblood Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Oxblood marks the system's hard prohibitions and nothing else: "untrusted / Level 4" in the Authority ladder, and "Never Automate / Zone 3" in the governance drawing. One semantic family — what the system must never treat as safe — always dashed or flagged, never decorative. (Amended 2026-08-26 to record the Zone 3 use carried over from the owner-approved Visual Wave.)

rules.name: The Spot-Field Rule
rules.body: Spot color commits at section scale (the olive letter, the terra-deep audit band) or at device scale (chips, squares, numerals). It is not used for tinted backgrounds behind ordinary prose.

rules.name: The Alias Bridge Rule
rules.body: :root retains legacy alias custom properties (--canvas, --panel, --accent, --accent-hover, --accent-muted, --text-primary, --text-secondary, --btn-ink) mapped onto the new tokens so inline SVG var() references inherit the world. Keep these aliases when porting pages that carry inline SVG; write new CSS against the new token names.

rules.name: The Courier Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime appears in exactly two places: the fifteen document file names in the schedule table, and the Operator prompt block. Nothing else — labels, tags, and numbers that look technical are Archivo 700 caps.

rules.name: The Besley Voice Rule
rules.body: Besley carries numerals (900 upright) and the human register (italic asides, promises, pull quotes, signatures). It never sets headings, UI labels, or body prose.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If an element needs separation, it gets a rule, a --paper-deep fill with a 1px ink border, or a spot-color field — never a shadow, glow, or gradient.

rules.name: The Printed Edge Rule
rules.body: Corners are square because print is square. A circle is never decoration; it is either the Operator or a plotted point.

dos: Do open every section with the running head device: a 1px ink top rule with a right-aligned tracked-caps label (paper-on-spot fields switch both to paper).
Do draw structure with the three-weight rule system: 2px ink to open, 1px ink to contain, 1px --rule (#C9BFA8) to divide rows; drop the rule on the last row.
Do keep paper text on terra-deep, olive, olive-deep, or ink fields only — the AA floor the build ships (~5:1 minimum).
Do keep the legacy alias custom properties in :root on any page carrying inline SVG var() references; write new styles against the new token names.
Do use the one physics for every entrance: settle-into-register (offset to 0, --ease-out), staggered under ~0.1s per part, with reduced-motion pinning final states.
Do give buttons and nav links 44px minimum touch targets on coarse pointers.
Do cap prose measures (52-64ch) and let hairline-ruled whitespace, not boxes, do the separating.
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients, glows, blur, or dark backgrounds — the material is flat ink on paper, single appearance, no dark mode.
Don't round a corner. Radius is 0 everywhere; circles are reserved for the Operator disc and plotted marks.
Don't set text on bright terra (#C7681D) or mustard (#D9A419) fields; they are large-mark and decorative-fill colors (the selection highlight is the lone shipped exception).
Don't use Courier Prime outside the fifteen file names and the Operator prompt; technical-looking labels are Archivo 700 tracked caps.
Don't use oxblood outside its prohibition semantics: untrusted/Level 4 and Never Automate/Zone 3.
Don't introduce new accent hues, pure black, or pure white; the palette is the twelve tokens above.
